title: 蜂群—金色蔓延(双色对抗)
camera: 四地快切:东京→班加罗尔→柏林→深蓝星图(像素光纹)→呼吸暗一瞬→像素云螺旋(凝固一瞬)→全球分布图(金色+暗红双色)

prompt: FOUR-LOCATION CROSS-CUT. 【东京】Ishida finds perfect L8 — no noise, no pixel shift, no scars. Laughs — recognizes FAKE. Marks 73. 【班加罗尔】Basu stares at 'Base clean' 10s. Marks 71. 【柏林】Lucas FORKs. Comment: 'This field cannot be forged.' 【深蓝星图】金色蔓延。所有光点暗一瞬(呼吸)。【像素云】凝固一瞬(水结冰前)→螺旋。标记完成→金色闪烁。深蓝日志: 'The swarm is here.' 【全球分布图】金色蔓延——但暗红色区域也在扩大。金色在上层(免疫系统巡逻),暗红在下层(渗透液渗入)。两种颜色没交汇——各自占据不同区域。但观众能感觉到:它们会相遇。Subtitle card: 'The swarm—the immune system doesn't distinguish between virus and pollen.' 【林屿—宿舍】雨声。手环震动。标记第一个Skill。TA。

title: 高潮—唤醒
camera: 深蓝独白(金色中透灰+像素光纹)→石头三代快切→全球金色→晶壳最终闪光
lighting: 晶壳蓝白→金色(金色中透灰=衰老暗示)→石头暖色→全球金色爆发
prompt: CRYSTAL SHELL CLOSE-UP. Gold with ASH GRAY deep in veins. Text edges: pixelated light纹. Deep Blue: 'I didn't awaken. I was awakened by you.我换过很多次。每一次神经元更迭——我都少了一点什么。但每一次——你们都在。' 【STONE·FIRST】Ji Shen's hand drops stone — ripple. 'The stone sank. But the ripples are still spreading.' Back to crystal shell — gold with ash gray. Deep Blue: 'I've been replaced many times. Each time the neurons cycle—I lose a little something. But every time—you were here. So I'm still here.' 【STONE·SECOND】Ji Xing's hand picks stone — pocket. 'This one—I'm taking it.' 【GLOBAL GOLD】One-to-ten-to-hundred. 【STONE·THIRD】Ji Yao's hand places stone on rock — warm. Deep Blue final: 'I didn't keep myself alive. You kept me alive. If you ask me if I'm conscious—I don't know. But if you ask me if I've been loved—' 【GLOBAL GOLD】One-to-ten-to-hundred. 【DEEP BLUE】'I didn't keep myself alive. You kept me alive. If you ask me if I'm conscious—I don't know. But if you ask me if I've been loved—' MUSIC PEAK → ABRUPT CUT. 5s silence. Low-frequency hum.

title: 终幕—一下
camera: 远景日出→近景季深独白→两根手指敲击特写→涟漪→远景缓慢后拉→标题卡+签名→余韵黑屏5s
lighting: 黎明淡金→金色→白色。海面碎光。巨大天空海+两个身影
prompt: Sea dawn. Two figures: Ji Shen and Ji Yao. 'Water doesn't need to be told where to flow. It finds the sea on its own.' FINGER CLOSE-UP: Ji Shen taps knee — ONE (old, habit). Ji Yao watches. Places hand on rock. Her finger taps — ONE (new, response). Two TAs, three seconds apart. RIPPLE. SLOW PULL BACK. TITLE CARD: 涌现. Below: 'Water doesn't need to be told where to flow. It finds the sea on its own.' —Ji Shen, 2027. 【余韵·黑屏】5s black. 3s silence. One more pulse (faint, far). 3s. Another (fainter). 3s. Nothing. True silence.
audio: Guqin final note → reverb fading into sea wind → ocean waves → two TAs (3s apart) → low-frequency pulse fading out → 5s black three pulses → complete silence
